title.narrative: Strengthening Judicial Capacity on the Rule of Law in the Maldives

description.narrative: UNESCO will provide capacity-building support to the Maldivian judiciary through partnership with the Maldives Judicial Academy, delivering integrated training on freedom of expression, access to information, and AI ethics with a gender-responsive approach. The support includes a 3-day training component (50% FOE/ROL, 50% AI), Training of Trainers for judicial trainers, and technical mapping for curriculum integration. This will strengthen judges' capacity to advance legal and institutional frameworks on FOE while addressing AI-mediated challenges, directly contributing to Indicator 5.1.CI.1.
